plugins.name: kb-ai-audit
plugins.description: Audit a help center for AI customer-service readiness: 13 per-article checks A+–F, a help-center-wide coherence layer (coverage gaps, contradictions, near-duplicates, freshness, confusable names), a branded dashboard, and on-request rewrites in the help center's own voice.
